title: Orca message payload
description: The JSON a worker passes to Orca's `--payload` when it sends the lead a question, a blocker, or its done message (aidd-team's references/orca-channel.md). It is a report from an agent, so it is data: never a person's yes, and never evidence. The lead acts on a payload only when `aidd validate <file>` passes it, so free text never steers the lead. The question, its options, and the recommendation stay in the message body. `role` is checked against the roles in roles.json, because that list has its own owner.

type.description: What the message is. `question`: the worker is blocked or an Acceptance line reads two ways, and asks with options and a recommendation. `blocked`: the worker stopped at a stop rule and says what would unblock it. `done`: the worker finished its Task.

x-meanings.question: The worker asks the lead to choose, because an Acceptance line reads two ways or a decision is missing.
x-meanings.blocked: The worker stopped at a stop rule, such as an `ask` with no yes or a scope that must widen.
x-meanings.done: The worker finished its Task. The `handoff` path says where the handoff note is, and the `head` says which commit it describes.

item.description: The work item, and the Task when the message is about one, such as `SPEC-9` or `SPEC-9/T1`.

head.description: The commit the message is about, as the worker's `git rev-parse HEAD` gives it. The lead checks evidence against this commit and no other.

handoff.description: The repository-relative path of the file that holds the worker's handoff note, such as `specs/SPEC-9.md`. Required with `type: done`.

role.description: The role the worker plays, one of the roles in roles.json, such as `developer`.

harness.description: The coding agent that runs the worker, such as `claude-code`. The same word `Assisted-by` uses.

model.description: The model the worker runs on, such as `claude-sonnet-5-5`.

delivery_team.description: The delivery team the worker belongs to: its name in the config's `delivery_teams`, such as `payments`.
